entries.rationale: A threshold of one intentionally makes every nontrivial exception visible and locally reasoned.
entries.safety_invariant: The threshold can only decrease; complexity may be exempted only at an exact governed source site.
entries.alternatives_considered: Using Clippy's default would hide widespread recovery debt instead of inventorying it.
entries.sentinel: strict Clippy and exact source-expectation inventory
entries.evidence: clippy.toml and the production, test, and benchmark source baselines

entries.rationale: These are canonical project and protocol identifiers whose casing is part of their public spelling.
entries.safety_invariant: The allowlist may shrink but cannot gain a new identifier without a separately reviewed policy entry.
entries.alternatives_considered: Rewriting the identifiers would make documentation less accurate.
entries.evidence: Current maintained documentation and public API terminology

entries.rationale: Four nested control levels is the reviewed maximum before a local exception must explain the invariant.
entries.safety_invariant: The threshold cannot rise and every remaining deeper site is governed explicitly.
entries.alternatives_considered: The default threshold would conceal known nesting debt.
entries.sentinel: strict Clippy and exact source-expectation inventory

entries.rationale: Five parameters is the reviewed default boundary; larger APIs must carry exact evidence until redesigned.
entries.safety_invariant: The threshold cannot rise and broad signature suppression is never implicit.
entries.alternatives_considered: A higher global threshold would hide store-trait and handler coupling that the recovery plan must address.
entries.sentinel: strict Clippy and exact source-expectation inventory

entries.rationale: Seventy-five lines keeps function-sized debt visible while structural file limits govern a separate concern.
entries.safety_invariant: The threshold cannot rise and each longer function must remain at its exact reviewed expectation.
entries.alternatives_considered: Relying only on file length would permit oversized functions inside smaller modules.
entries.sentinel: strict Clippy and exact source-expectation inventory

entries.rationale: The reviewed ceiling keeps complex types visible without masking them at the crate level.
entries.safety_invariant: The threshold cannot rise and remaining exceptions must identify the exact type boundary.
entries.alternatives_considered: A broad allow or default threshold would obscure aliases that should be simplified.
entries.sentinel: strict Clippy and exact source-expectation inventory
